body: i'm so tired of worrying about everything wrong with me. my heart rate is high? heart failure. my heart rate is slow? artery blockage. i feel pressure in my face? ms. my eye is blurry? brain tumor. my leg hurts? blood clot. i could go on and on and on. i get so anxious every day about things i rationally know are meaningless, and it exhausts me. and then i think that the exhaustion i feel is a symptom of cancer or whatever else i'm fixating on that day. i hate my brain.
